purpose: Educational landscape seasons — describe what kind of period we appear to be in. Not prediction.

seasons.label: Major ransomware activity
seasons.explanation: Public reporting and sample campaigns emphasize disruptive ransomware themes. Preparedness centers on backups, patching, and remote-access hygiene.

seasons.label: Supply chain campaigns
seasons.explanation: Teaching cases highlight trust in update channels and vendor software. Inventory clarity matters more than volume of alerts.

seasons.label: Patch Tuesday / vendor patch window
seasons.explanation: A calmer operational season for reviewing vendor updates against your inventory — not an emergency siren.

seasons.label: Large cloud outages
seasons.explanation: When public cloud availability dominates headlines, cyber vulnerability volume may be quiet. Resilience and dependency literacy matter.

seasons.label: Identity-focused attacks
seasons.explanation: Educational focus on account takeover and phishing themes. MFA and recovery paths outweigh exotic exploit chatter.

seasons.label: Critical browser vulnerabilities
seasons.explanation: When browser components dominate disclosures, update cadence and extension hygiene become the calm priority.

seasons.label: Quieter window
seasons.explanation: No dominant theme asserted from sample signals. Ordinary hygiene still matters — quiet is not complacency.
